name: walk_tired
text: A very tired person slowly trudges forward in a straight line. Head hanging low, upper back rounded forward and shoulders slumped. Both arms dangle loosely at the sides with very little swing. Heavy dragging short alternating footsteps, barely lifting the feet. Keep walking steadily throughout, never stop or turn.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 低头塌肩、圆背前倾，双臂下垂少摆；沉重小步前行，循环端点一致。
